identity.title: A Radio-to-mm Census of Star-forming Galaxies in Protocluster 4C23.56 at Z = 2.5: Gas Mass and Its Fraction Revealed with ALMA

paper_type_evidence.quote: We investigate gas contents of star-forming galaxies associated with protocluster 4C23.56 at z = 2.49 by using the redshifted CO (3–2) and 1.1 mm dust continuum with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array.
